scope: Server authorization contract and account preference persistence for forthcoming game activity integration; not a working publisher.
implementation: Account privacy fields shareGameActivity (default false), gameActivityNewServerAudience (all/small/none, default none) and gameActivityServerOverrides (boolean map up to 1024 entries) have additive server validation and client account cache/pending-write support.

GameActivityPrivacyPolicy checks explicit master consent, visible online state, two-way blocking and accepted friendship. Server-context queries additionally require both users' current membership, then enforce server audience/overrides for nonfriends. Small-server threshold is 200 members; global context is accepted friends only. Self-view remains allowed.

Dependency and malformed stored preference errors return denial with error. Callers must deny on error; channel-specific access and trustworthy activity provenance are separate requirements. No path/process inventory is accepted by this policy.
